arms.detail: SIGKILL node A after write intent; resume on node B reported outcome_unknown; write not re-sent

claim: A program killed mid-run on one node resumed on another and never repeated a write; a write interrupted in flight is marked outcome unknown for a person to resolve.
honesty: Tier C lab: two celld nodes, one object-storage provider that passed diagnose conditional-write. Not a durable execution engine; not exactly-once delivery. Not the AWS three-arm cost board; host WORM continuity still separate.
